profile.editorialTitle: Transforming Complex Datasets into Actionable Intelligence.
profile.bio: An accomplished Information Systems graduate, I, Aditia Dika, am a dedicated professional targeting a challenging role in data science and artificial intelligence. My academic background and technical expertise position me as a promising data scientist committed to leveraging advanced analytical techniques to derive meaningful insights and drive strategic decision-making. With a comprehensive understanding of data manipulation, machine learning algorithms, and predictive modeling, I am enthusiastic about applying my skills to transform complex datasets into actionable intelligence for organizations. Excited to contribute as a collaborative team member, I am driven to make impactful contributions that directly drive business growth and technological innovation.

projects.title: Chili Plant Health Classification via Multispectral Camera
projects.summary: Sistem klasifikasi tingkat kesehatan tanaman cabai berbasis citra Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) dan format RGN menggunakan arsitektur deep learning CNN-EfficientNetB3 untuk smart farming presisi.
highlights: Pengumpulan data primer dan pemrosesan citra multispektral format RGN.
Pembuatan dan kurasi dataset citra tanaman cabai berbasis indeks vegetasi (NDVI).
Eksperimen pemodelan klasifikasi tingkat kesehatan tanaman menggunakan arsitektur CNN-EfficientNetB3.
Kolaborasi dengan tim IoT untuk integrasi modul inferensi AI di lapangan.

projects.summary: Aplikasi dashboard pemantauan kinerja harian dan manajemen tugas internal instansi dengan pemodelan sistem terstruktur serta antarmuka modern yang responsif.
highlights: Analisis kebutuhan pengguna dan permodelan proses bisnis menggunakan UML (Use Case, Activity, Class, Sequence) dan ERD.
Perancangan wireframe dengan Balsamiq dan prototype interaktif menggunakan Figma.
Pengembangan web application menggunakan PHP (CodeIgniter 4), JavaScript, Bootstrap, dan MySQL.
Deployment dan integrasi sistem ke hosting produksi.
